head_commit.message:
fix(ime): call TextView setter before invalidating caches

Forward every text and buffer type to TextView before invalidating the custom
measurement and transform caches. Drop the content comparison, which cannot
represent buffer conversions or filtering performed by the parent setter.
Keep constructor-time calls safe by marking caches dirty without reading them.

workflow_runs.name: Pull Request
workflow_runs.display_title: perf: initialize input feedback resources on demand

head_commit.message:
perf: initialize input feedback resources on demand

Avoid connecting to a speech engine and allocating a custom sound pool when
feedback is disabled. Retain the application context and create each backend
only when enabled feedback needs it, waiting for initialization before use.

Confine speech requests from Rime jobs to the main thread and invalidate queued
requests at input lifecycle boundaries. Reject callbacks from released resources
and avoid retrying failed initialization on every key press. Cover resource
ownership and worker dispatch with focused regression tests.
